what: Header row right-side ”Say hello” button — five dots stand beside the text in an arrow shape (the middle one pointing right), and on hover the background swells elastically to 1.038 wide·1.068 tall (.45s), the dots shift .125rem to the right (.45s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), each .048s later), and inside the dots an accent dot fills in from .55rem on the left (.55s, .064s later). Pressing squeezes it to .955·.954

options.--fx-fill-dur: Length for the accent dot to fill up, default .55s

use: Say hello

from.where: shared.css .b-talk — original .btn-arrow (.btn-bg scale 1.038 1.068 · .btn-dot five items margin-right --index×.1875rem, translateX .125rem .45s · ::before accent color translateX(-.55rem) scale(0)→0·1 .55s · :active scale .955 .954)

note: The original background curve --elastic-ease-out value is not in the bundle, so it is approximated with cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1). To make it follow like a magnet, attach magnetic-hover as well
